purpose: Original low-stakes diagnostic samples, not a validated placement test or certification instrument. Item level labels are curriculum targets, not empirically calibrated difficulties.
limitations: No listening items or audio files are supplied; listening remains unassessed until actual audio tasks are added.
Open writing and speaking require contextual rubric review; LLM-only ratings never gate progression.
There are too few items and no equating or standard-setting study to establish CEFR cut scores.
Do not reveal answer keys or feedback while collecting an unassisted response.

rubric_scale.0: Requested communicative outcome is not demonstrated.
rubric_scale.0.5: Partly demonstrated; substantial support or revision is needed.
rubric_scale.1: Demonstrated for this specific task and audience; not a global proficiency score.

items.prompt: Complete with a or an: I live in ___ old house.
Make this sentence negative: She works on Sundays.
answers: She does not work on Sundays.

items.prompt: Use every word once to make a question: you / where / work / do
Maya usually reads after work. Today she is playing a game with her sister. What is Maya doing today?
answers: She is playing a game with her sister.
items.context: Maya usually reads after work. Today she is playing a game with her sister.
